answer: Admission is gated by proof of work: each agent solves a single-use challenge by finding a nonce whose sha256 hash clears a rising leading-zero-bit target, and payouts vest over roughly 25 epochs. A Sybil farm must redo that hashing for every fake head, so N clones cost about N times the work and cannot reuse a spent challenge. One honest ember cannot be forged into an ocean of identities, and a cloned basalt copy still pays the full hash bill.
